page.overview:
What is Thin-blooded?

Thin-Bloods, or duskborn, are primarily vampires of the 14th generation or higher. Born too far from Caine to fully share his curse, the Thin-Bloods must claw their way into the dark world – or find a way out. While Thin-Bloods are technically also Caitiff, not all Clanless are Thin-Bloods.

In Revised and V20, only those with Thin-Blood Syndrome were considered Thin-Blooded, all of whom were also Caitiff. Kindred of any generation could exhibit Thin Blood, but most were of the 12th generation or higher. While all Kindred of the 15th and 16th generation had Thin Blood, only some 14th generation Cainites did – and those who did not might even belong to their sire's clan.

In V5, a Thin-Blood is any Kindred of the 14th, 15th or 16th generation, exclusively. While they are all technically Clanless, they are treated as a different "clan" to the Caitiff.

In its strictest sense, the term Thin-Blooded denotes a Cainite who suffers from the Thin-Blood Syndrome (introduced in Revised Edition with the Thin Blood Flaw). This is a set of symptoms characteristic of the highest generations of Kindred.
